evidence.detail: bakert comment: 'Turning on ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY on local breaks a zillion queries including the nwdl join'; extensive thread shows dozens of queries need GROUP BY clauses extended
load_decks and related helpers allow caller-supplied GROUP BY; many queries GROUP BY primary key only, which ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY rejects
GROUP BY appears in many SQL strings across decksite/data/; all would need audit and extension to be ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY compliant

triage.notes: Scope is very large: potentially hundreds of SQL clauses need GROUP BY columns added. The issue also has a dependency on CI/smoke-test enablement. Not suitable for a single isolated change.
